en: A vintage postcard featuring an illustration of a large ocean liner with four smokestacks, identified as the 'Paquebot France' operated by the Compagnie Générale Transatlantique. The ship is shown at sea with a smaller vessel in the foreground. French and English text provides details about the ship's size and tonnage. The background is sepia-toned, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
